description: This file defines a TelemetryClient class for handling telemetry events, including tracking events and page visits, and exports a singleton instance. It also includes constants for telemetry categories and actions, and references external modules IUser and TelemetryHandler.

classes.name: TelemetryClient
classes.description: A class for managing telemetry events, including setting handlers and user info, and tracking events and page visits.

methods.name: setTelemetryHandler
methods.description: Sets the telemetry handler used to send telemetry data.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Assigns a user object to the telemetry client.

methods.name: trackEvent
methods.description: Tracks a telemetry event with specified category, event name, and optional properties.

methods.name: pageVisited
methods.description: Logs a page visit event with specified category and page name.
